# Millicent Rogers

# Board of Education Vice Chair

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/rogers-profile.jpeg)

- Promotes herself as an “**[anti-racist](https://www.instagram.com/p/C05BWwjOpK2/?hl=en)**” school board member.
- Voted for March 31, 2025 **[to be celebrated](https://citizenportal.ai/articles/6102641/North-Carolina/Durham-board-unanimously-recognizes-March-31-as-Transgender-Day-of-Visibility?ss=&af=-14087&source=ballotpedia)** in Durham Public Schools as “Transgender Day of Visibility.”
- Supports the **[LGBTQIA and Gender Support policy](https://go.boarddocs.com/nc/dpsnc/Board.nsf/goto?open&id=CLXMPG5A4FA0)** that allows school employees to keep secrets from parents about gender transitioning of their children at school.
